memo_model: bypass exact same-parent repeats, query only memo misses
associativity_model: ordinary per-set LRU with explicitly accounted order bytes, not stateless victim selection; one order byte per slot for ways above 1, zero metadata for direct mapped

hash_definitions.raw_current_fnv1a: FNV-1a 64 over 8 occupancy words, identical to engine occupancy_hash
hash_definitions.murmur_fmix64_finalized_fingerprint: murmur3 fmix64 applied to rot-xor occupancy fingerprint

set_index: finalized hash masked to power-of-two set count
hit_rule: claimed hit requires full exact board equality between requested board and currently live referenced node
